name: SkyTranslate – AI Bulk Translate for TranslatePress
author: Sky Plugins

sections.description:
SEO Friendly AI Auto Translate for TranslatePress (by SkyTranslate) helps you effortlessly fetch strings from TranslatePress preview pages and translate content in bulk directly from the WordPress admin.

Key Features

  • Bulk Translation: Translate published Posts and Pages in bulk using free Google Translate tools.
  • SEO Friendly: Automatically translates SEO meta tags on the frontend (including Page Title, Meta Description, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, and Dublin Core), ensuring your translated pages rank well in search engines.
  • Editor Integration: Fetches strings directly from the TranslatePress preview to ensure bulk results stay perfectly aligned with what the editor sees.
  • Smart Processing: Option to skip already translated languages, saving time and processing power.

🚀 Upgrade to SkyTranslate Pro: Context-Aware Premium AI

While the free version processes strings individually with Google Translate, SkyTranslate Pro unlocks Context-Aware AI Translation using Premium AI models like OpenAI (GPT-5, GPT-4), Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini.

  • Context-Aware Translation: Sends groups of related strings together, so the AI understands the full context and surrounding sentences.
  • Human-Quality Results: Get natural, fluent, and publication-ready translations instead of literal word-for-word outputs.
  • Custom Post Types: Unlocks auto-translate support for all your Custom Post Types.
  • Tone Consistency: Correctly resolves ambiguous phrases and maintains tone and terminology consistency across your site.

Get SkyTranslate Pro Now!

Third-Party Services

This free plugin uses the free Google Translate API as a third-party service to power its automated translations. By using this plugin, your translation text strings are sent to Google for processing.

  • Service Used: Google Translate API
  • Terms of Service: Google Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy

We strongly encourage you to review Google’s terms and privacy policies, as your usage is subject to them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/skytranslate-bulk-translate directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the SkyPlugins menu in the WordPress admin to configure the plugin.
